sources.scope_note: Mixkit Free Sound Effects license permits use in online marketing/advertising; standalone redistribution is not allowed.
Mixkit Free Stock Music license covers social media and online marketing; other media scopes must be checked before use.
Pixabay content is broadly usable in creative works, but third-party rights and item-specific restrictions still need review.
CC0 items are suitable for commercial use; record the item page and checksum.
CC-BY requires attribution; attribution text is stored with the asset.
Treat YouTube Audio Library as YouTube-scoped unless the specific track license explicitly grants broader rights.
Real international/Thai songs can enter the pipeline only with explicit license evidence covering the intended platform, territory, term, and advertising use.
